findings.reason: English says 'ready for real-time use'; the translation narrows this to 'real-time rendering', adding information not in the source.

findings.span: AI 鏡頭運動
findings.suggestion: AI 相機運動
findings.reason: Glossary requires 'camera' → 相機; the extendedDescription already uses 相機運動, so the description's 鏡頭運動 is both off-glossary and inconsistent within the page.

findings.span: 具備 AI 鏡頭運動與角色一致性
findings.suggestion: 產生單一影片輸出，具備 AI 相機運動與一致的角色生成
findings.reason: Omits the English 'producing a single video output'.

findings.span: 或 flow 節點
findings.suggestion: 或流程節點
findings.reason: 'flow' is left untranslated in the middle of Chinese prose although it is not a proper noun or node name; reads as an untranslated leftover.

findings.span: 一張圖作產品身份
findings.suggestion: 一張圖作產品身分
findings.reason: Inconsistent orthography for 'identity' across the page: extendedDescription and howToUse use 身分 while suggestedUseCases and FAQ use 身份; 身分 is the standard zh-TW form.

findings.span: 影像轉影片
findings.suggestion: 圖片轉影片
findings.reason: Capitalized 'Image' in the title must use the required UI term 圖片 (lowercase 'image' maps to 影像). The body text correctly uses 影像轉影片 for the lowercase 'image-to-video', but the title should follow the capitalized mapping.

findings.span: 適合時尚、社論與產品動態內容
findings.suggestion: 適合時尚、雜誌編輯風格與產品動態內容
findings.reason: 'Editorial' here means fashion/magazine editorial imagery; 社論 means a newspaper op-ed, which is the wrong sense and reads nonsensically in a fashion/product context.

findings.span: 適合社論與產品
findings.suggestion: 適合雜誌編輯風格與產品
findings.reason: Same mistranslation of 'editorial' as 社論 (newspaper op-ed) instead of fashion/magazine editorial style.

findings.span: 3 個社論式剪接點
findings.suggestion: 3 個雜誌編輯風格的剪接點
findings.reason: 'Editorial cuts' refers to magazine/fashion editorial-style editing; 社論式 (op-ed-style) is the wrong sense of 'editorial'.

findings.span: 時尚/社論人像
findings.suggestion: 時尚/雜誌編輯風格人像
findings.reason: 'Fashion/editorial portraits' mistranslated; 社論 (newspaper editorial/op-ed) is the wrong meaning for portrait photography.

findings.span: 社論人像
findings.suggestion: 雜誌編輯風格人像
findings.reason: 'Editorial portraits' mistranslated as op-ed portraits; wrong sense of 'editorial' in a photography context.

findings.span: 依節拍剪輯出 3 個 cut
findings.suggestion: 依節拍剪輯出 3 個剪接點
findings.reason: The English word 'cut' is left untranslated mid-sentence while the same concept is rendered as 剪接點 elsewhere in the page, creating inconsistent, awkward mixed-language phrasing.

findings.span: 風格參考生成
findings.suggestion: 風格參考
findings.reason: The English title is just 'Style Reference'; the translation adds '生成' (generation), information not present in the source. Titles should stay as concise labels.

findings.span: 生成符合提示內容
findings.suggestion: 產生符合提示內容
findings.reason: Required UI term mapping is Generate → 產生. The page is also internally inconsistent: extendedDescription uses 產生 ('文字轉圖像產生', '發出產生請求') while description/metaDescription/howToUse use 生成.

findings.span: 點擊 Queue/Execute 執行圖形
findings.suggestion: 點擊「佇列／執行」執行圖形
findings.reason: UI terms left untranslated; required mappings are Queue → 佇列 and Execute → 執行, so the labels do not match the ComfyUI app's Chinese UI.

findings.span: MiniMax：影片生成
findings.suggestion: MiniMax：影片
findings.reason: The English title is 'MiniMax: Video'; the translation adds '生成' (generation), which is not in the source, and is also inconsistent with the rest of the page where the workflow name is kept as 'MiniMax: Video'.

findings.span: 生成高品質影片
findings.suggestion: 產生高品質影片
findings.reason: Glossary requires 'Generate' to be rendered as 產生, not 生成.

findings.span: 根據文字提示生成高品質影片
findings.suggestion: 根據文字提示詞產生高品質影片
findings.reason: Inconsistent terminology within the page: 'text prompts' is rendered 文字提示 here but 文字提示詞 in the metaDescription, extendedDescription, howToUse and FAQ.

findings.span: 支援首幀控制
findings.suggestion: 支援可選的首幀控制
findings.reason: The source says 'optional first-frame control'; the word 'optional' is omitted here (it is preserved elsewhere in the page).

findings.span: 為社群平台製作宣傳影片內容。
findings.suggestion: 為社群媒體平台製作宣傳影片內容。
findings.reason: Glossary requires 'Social media' → 社群媒體; translation uses 社群 only.

findings.span: 15 次取樣步數
findings.suggestion: 15 個取樣步驟
findings.reason: Mixing the counter '次' with '步數' (step count) is redundant/awkward; a native writer would say '15 個取樣步驟' or '15 步取樣'.

findings.span: FLUX 套件在底層包含提示 upsampler 文字編碼器
findings.suggestion: FLUX 套件包含提示 upsampler 文字編碼器
findings.reason: 'under the hood' is rendered twice — once as '在底層包含' and again as '在背景使用' later in the same sentence; the first instance also misattributes it to 'includes'.

findings.span: 快速概念圖
findings.suggestion: 快速概念設計
findings.reason: 'rapid concept art' is rendered as '快速概念設計' in the description but '快速概念圖' here; the same phrase should be consistent across the page.

findings.span: Sprite Sheet 動畫產生器
findings.suggestion: Sprite Sheet 產生器
findings.reason: The title adds '動畫' (animation), which is not in the English title 'Sprite Sheet Generator'; it is also half-translated while the extendedDescription and howToUse keep the full English name 'Sprite Sheet Generator', creating an inconsistent page.

findings.span: 從單一圖片生成動畫影格
findings.suggestion: 從單一影像產生動畫影格
findings.reason: 'Generate' must be rendered as 產生 per the required UI-term mapping (the title already uses 產生器), and lowercase 'image' should be 影像.

findings.span: 上傳角色圖像
findings.suggestion: 上傳你的 sprite 影像
findings.reason: 'sprite' is rendered as 角色 (character) here, while the rest of the page keeps 'sprite' in English; also 'image' should be 影像 per the term mapping, whereas 圖像/圖片/影像 are used inconsistently across the page.

findings.span: 為創意專案生成原型動畫。
findings.suggestion: 為創意專案產生原型動畫。
findings.reason: 'Generating' must use the required translation 產生 rather than 生成, for consistency with the rest of the entry.

findings.span: 在 ComfyUI 載入流程
findings.suggestion: 在 ComfyUI 載入此工作流程
findings.reason: 'workflow' must be rendered as 工作流程 (and 'this workflow' as 此工作流程). Here and in several other places it is shortened to 流程 ('process'), which is inconsistent with 'ComfyUI 工作流程' used in the extended description of the same entry.

findings.span: 流程自動偵測最無縫的起始影格
findings.suggestion: 此工作流程自動偵測最無縫的起始影格
findings.reason: Same issue: 'This workflow' should be 此工作流程, not the bare 流程; creates inconsistency across the page.

findings.span: 您可選擇該索引
findings.suggestion: 你可選擇該索引
findings.reason: Required second-person pronoun mapping is 'You → 你'; 您 is used here while the rest of the entry avoids/uses the plain form.

findings.span: 組合最終提示文字
findings.suggestion: 組合最終的條件設定文字
findings.reason: English says 'final conditioning text'; the translation drops the 'conditioning' concept, which has a required rendering (條件設定).

findings.span: 本流程針對持續、靜態浮水印（如角落標誌或日期戳記）最佳。
findings.suggestion: 本流程針對持續、靜態的浮水印（如角落標誌或日期戳記）進行最佳化。
findings.reason: '最佳' used as a predicate is ungrammatical here; 'optimized for' should be rendered as 針對…最佳化.

findings.span: 購買授權素材後清理庫存影片
findings.suggestion: 購買授權素材後清理該素材影片
findings.reason: 'stock footage' is rendered twice (授權素材 and 庫存影片), producing a redundant and confusing phrase; 庫存影片 also reads as 'inventory video'.

findings.span: 以 LTX 2.3 LoRA 引導的修補步驟
findings.suggestion: 以 LTX 2.3 LoRA 引導的局部修補步驟
findings.reason: Inpainting is required to be 局部修補; howToUse uses 局部修補 while the extendedDescription/metaDescription/FAQ use only 修補, creating inconsistency across the page.

findings.span: denoise 強度
findings.suggestion: 去雜訊強度
findings.reason: The same parameter is left in English here but translated as 去雜訊強度 in the FAQ, an inconsistency within the same entry.

findings.span: 並確保遮罩設定完整覆蓋浮水印區域
findings.suggestion: 並確保自訂節點中的修補遮罩設定完整覆蓋浮水印區域
findings.reason: Omits 'in the custom node' from 'the inpainting mask settings in the custom node', losing the location of the setting.

findings.span: 已暴露的 SeedVR2 參數
findings.suggestion: 節點中可調整的 SeedVR2 參數
findings.reason: '已暴露的' is a literal rendering of 'exposed' that reads awkwardly/negatively in Traditional Chinese; 'exposed parameters' here means parameters made available for adjustment.

findings.span: 細節小幅回復
findings.suggestion: 細節小幅恢復
findings.reason: '回復' normally means 'to reply' in Traditional Chinese usage; '恢復' is the correct word for 'recovery/restoration' of detail.

findings.span: 以及最高約 ~6.2MP
findings.suggestion: 以及最高約 6.2MP
findings.reason: Redundant double approximation marker: the Chinese 約 ('approximately') is combined with the '~' symbol. Same pattern recurs in howToUse ('接近或低於約 ~6.2 MP', '最多約 ~4.5k tokens') and faqItems ('最高約 ~6.2 百萬像素'); one marker is enough.

findings.span: 直接設定自訂寬/高並連到 API 節點
findings.suggestion: 直接設定自訂寬/高
findings.reason: Adds an instruction ('and connect it to the API node') that is not present in the English source sentence, which only says to remove it and set custom width/height directly.

findings.span: 外擴繪製
findings.suggestion: 影像外擴
findings.reason: 'Outpainting' is rendered as 外擴繪製 in the description/metaDescription but as 影像外擴 in the extendedDescription and FAQ, and simply 外擴 in howToUse; the page should use one consistent term.

findings.span: 無痕圖片編輯
findings.suggestion: 無痕影像編輯
findings.reason: Glossary maps lowercase 'image' to 影像; the rest of the page uses 影像 for image, so 圖片 here is inconsistent.

findings.span: 使用 LoadImage 節點匯入圖片，完成素材準備。
findings.suggestion: 使用 LoadImage 節點將影像匯入工作流程，完成素材準備。
findings.reason: 'image' should be 影像 per glossary and page consistency; also omits 'into the workflow'.

findings.span: Gemini 以圖生圖
findings.suggestion: 雙子星 以圖生圖
findings.reason: Glossary requires the product-UI term 'Gemini' to be rendered as 雙子星 for consistency with the ComfyUI app; it is left in English here (node name GeminiImage2Node should stay English, but the standalone term should follow the glossary).

findings.span: Comfy 廣告選角預視
findings.suggestion: Comfy 廣告應用 - 演員選角
findings.reason: The English title 'Comfy for Advertising - Talent Casting' contains no word for 'previs'; the translation adds 預視, information not present in the source title.

findings.span: GeminiImage2Node 以圖生圖生成帶參考的預視圖
findings.suggestion: GeminiImage2Node 使用大頭照以及任何選用的產品／環境參照，進行以圖生圖的引導式合成
findings.reason: Omits that the synthesis uses the headshot plus optional product/environment references, compressing the source detail.

findings.span: Queue/執行工作流程
findings.suggestion: 將工作流程排入佇列／執行
findings.reason: The UI term 'Queue' is left untranslated; the required zh-TW rendering is 佇列.

findings.span: 原始照片不會被覆蓋
findings.suggestion: 保持原始照片不變
findings.reason: EN says 'keeping your original photo intact' (unchanged), not 'will not be overwritten' — slight shift in meaning.

findings.span: 現場快速產生建議髮型與色系，協助溝通。
findings.suggestion: 諮詢時快速產生建議髮型與色系的視覺參考。
findings.reason: Omits 'visual references' from the source and adds '協助溝通' (helps communication), which is not in the English.

findings.span: 在沙龍前快速試剪短髮、瀏海、層次與各種髮色
findings.suggestion: 在前往美髮沙龍前快速試短髮、瀏海、層次與各種髮色
findings.reason: '在沙龍前' reads as 'in front of the salon'; 'before a salon visit' should be 前往美髮沙龍前 in natural zh-TW.

findings.span: 測試特殊色彩與造型，無需永久改變。
findings.suggestion: 測試特殊色彩與造型以貼近角色設定，無需永久改變。
findings.reason: Omits 'to match a character' from the English source.

findings.span: 在 ComfyUI 中載入 Hairstyle Changer 工作流程
findings.suggestion: 在 ComfyUI 中載入髮型變換器工作流程
findings.reason: The workflow name is translated as 髮型變換器 in the title and extendedDescription but left in English here, creating inconsistency within the page.
